pictures.name: TR1-Grain-Store
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A busy old grain store in Sultanpur in the early 1500s: high mud-brick walls, open sacks of wheat and lentils, a big hanging balance scale with brass pans, villagers waiting with cloth bags. At the scale, a young man in a simple white kurta and a soft turban, the young Guru Nanak, seen only from behind, his face never visible, weighs grain. Shafts of gold light through dust, deep blue shadows.

pictures.name: TR5-Accounts
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Inside the grain store: clerks in robes and turbans count sacks stacked to the rafters and check a large balance scale, an open ledger with only faint unreadable marks on the table. They look at each other in surprise: everything is full. The Nawab in his rich blue robe and white turban stands in the doorway, astonished. Gold light, dusty air.

pictures.name: TR6-Today-Breath
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. A modern home kitchen at dawn. A middle-aged Sikh man in a maroon turban and a grey sweater, a steel kara on his wrist, stirs a pot of lentils on the stove, his eyes softly half-closed, breathing slowly with a peaceful face. A kettle steams beside him, gold sunrise at the window, deep blue shadows in the room. Quiet, prayerful, ordinary.
